purpose: Fail-closed intake of real primary-research exports into NF06 without contaminating evidence with identifiers or synthetic records.

record_envelope.response_id: opaque cryptographically random server-generated identifier; no identity lookup table
record_envelope.schema_version: must equal nf.primary_payload.v0.1 unless a later explicitly reconciled schema is frozen
record_envelope.answers: object validated against the selected adult/employer payload schema

pii_text_screen.note: Automated screening is a safety net, not proof of anonymity; free-text review remains required before publication of quotations.

fail_closed_conditions: invalid JSON or unsupported top-level structure
forbidden key present anywhere in record
PII-like token found in free text
any expected region absent when declaring the three-region gate closed

outputs.normalized_jsonl: validated records only, still pseudonymous and not a public artifact
outputs.ingest_report_json: raw hash, input/valid/rejected counts, duplicate count, region/strata counts, error list, gate state
outputs.evidence_promotion: FORBIDDEN until report PASS, research frame/coverage metadata are attached, and raw export reconciliation is complete

validation_receipt.note: Fixtures used only to validate software behavior and are NON-EVIDENCE; no fixture values are persisted as project evidence.
